effect_description_eng: [On Play] Reveal the top 4 cards of your deck. Add 1 Digimon card with the [Rock Dragon], [Earth Dragon], [Bird Dragon], [Machine Dragon] or [Sky Dragon] trait and 1 [Hina Kurihara] among them to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [All Turns] While this Digimon has an [On Play] effect, it gets +1000 DP.
